Rule of an anchor pixel selection criterion

Source: R/metric-anchors.R
ef_anchor_rule.Rd

Builds one rule of the selection criteria of anchor pixels, for example "NDVI at or above the 95th percentile of the scene" or "albedo between 0.10 and 0.35". Rules are combined in ef_anchor_criteria(). A rule states its variable, operator, threshold and whether the threshold is an absolute value or a percentile of the scene; nothing has a default value, because no threshold for anchor selection has been verified against a primary source.

Usage

ef_anchor_rule(variable, operator, value, scale)

Arguments

variable

Character. Layer the rule applies to: "lst" (surface temperature [K]), "ndvi" [-], "albedo" [-], "lai" [m2 m-2] or "land_cover" (integer class codes).

operator

Character. One of ">=", ">", "<=", "<", "between" (closed interval, value = c(lower, upper)) or "in" (membership in a set of class codes; only for "land_cover", which only accepts "in").

value

Numeric. Threshold, in the unit of variable when scale = "absolute", or a probability in (0, 1] when scale = "percentile". Length 2 for "between", one or more class codes for "in", length 1 otherwise. Missing and infinite values are not allowed.

scale

Character. "absolute" (the threshold is value) or "percentile" (the threshold is the quantile of variable at probability value, computed in the percentile domain and with the quantile type set in ef_anchor_criteria()).

Value

A list of class earthflux_anchor_rule with elements variable, operator, value and scale.

Details

A cell satisfies the rule when variable (at the cell) compared with the threshold by operator is TRUE; a missing value never satisfies a rule. Invalid arguments raise errors of class earthflux_input_error (missing arguments: earthflux_missing_input; unknown variable, operator or scale: earthflux_unknown_method).

Verification status: the rule is a container; the thresholds a user passes are not verified by the package. Values observed in the water package (for example NDVI percentile 0.95 and LAI >= 4 for the cold anchor) are CANDIDATA without a verified primary source (dev/specs/anchor-pixels.md section 3).

See also

Other anchor pixel functions: ef_anchor_conditions(), ef_anchor_criteria(), ef_anchor_pick(), ef_anchors(), ef_homogeneity(), ef_select_anchors()

Examples

# Cold anchor candidates: NDVI at or above the scene's 95th percentile
ef_anchor_rule("ndvi", ">=", 0.95, scale = "percentile")
#> $variable
#> [1] "ndvi"
#> 
#> $operator
#> [1] ">="
#> 
#> $value
#> [1] 0.95
#> 
#> $scale
#> [1] "percentile"
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "earthflux_anchor_rule" "list"                 

# Hot anchor candidates: albedo between 0.10 and 0.35 (absolute)
ef_anchor_rule("albedo", "between", c(0.10, 0.35), scale = "absolute")
#> $variable
#> [1] "albedo"
#> 
#> $operator
#> [1] "between"
#> 
#> $value
#> [1] 0.10 0.35
#> 
#> $scale
#> [1] "absolute"
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "earthflux_anchor_rule" "list"
